collapsed_body.interpretation: COM-Poisson remains better than the older categorical movement benchmark but slightly worsens the already-strong full-support Poisson collapsed body.

dispersion_stability.interpretation: The selected under-dispersion is very small. It consistently nudges tail proper scores but is far too weak to repair the large absolute 8+/9+ continuation bias.

scientific_interpretation: A canonical global under-dispersion parameter improves conditional-tail proper score robustly but does not solve absolute tail calibration and does not establish stable pooled exact-T improvement. The remaining exact-tail problem is not justified as further distribution-family shopping on the viewed development labels. The next defensible step requires a different data plan: freeze a specific tail-calibration mechanism before opening genuinely fresh calibration/confirmation labels, or obtain orthogonal high-tail information such as richer dynamic multi-line O/U.
stopping_rule: C078-B is parked. Do not sequentially test double-Poisson, generalized-Poisson, finite-binomial, additional COM-Poisson parameterizations, exponential tilts, mixtures or other neighboring thin-tail families on the same viewed C074-E/C078 tail labels.
